name: patch
description: Lists and lands the patches that subagents in worktrees left. Use when a subagent in a worktree stopped, ended, or reported work, and before you remove its worktree.
---

A hook writes one patch for each subagent in a worktree, after each `Edit` and `Write` of the agent.
The patch is in `.claudetto/patches/<agentId>/changes.patch` of the main checkout, and the file `base` in the same folder holds the base commit.
The patch holds all changes of the agent since that commit, also the new files and the commits of the agent.
It stays after the worktree is gone.

## Land a Patch

1. List the patches: `bun ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/claudetto-patch list`.
2. Land one: `bun ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/bin/claudetto-patch land <agentId>`.
   It applies the patch only when the patch applies cleanly.
3. Review the change with `git diff`, run the checks, and commit.

When the patch does not apply, the command changes no file and prints the error of git.
Send the patch back to an agent that rebases it onto `HEAD`, or ask the user.
Run `land <agentId> --3way` only when you will resolve the conflict markers by hand.
Never choose a side of a conflict without reading both sides.

## Continue the Work of an Agent That Stopped

Tell the new agent in its brief to read `.claudetto/patches/<agentId>/changes.patch` first.
It applies the patch with `git apply` in its own worktree, and continues from there.
